title: Ordinary restriction of scalars respects the inverse-image square compositor
statement:
Let $A,B$ be commutative rings and $\varphi:A\to B$ a ring homomorphism. Let $h:U'\to U$, $j':U'\to X'$, $j:U\to X$ and $g:X'\to X$ form an open-immersion square [def-cbc-open-immersion-square]. Write $P_R(f)$ for ordinary constant-ring module inverse image [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], $R_T$ for restriction along $\varphi$ [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction], $q_f:P_A(f)R_W\to R_VP_B(f)$ for its specified restriction/pullback mate for $f:V\to W$, and $c_R:P_R(j')P_R(g)\cong P_R(h)P_R(j)$ for the specified moduleSquareG [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-base-change]. For every $B$-module sheaf $M$ on $X$,
$$q_{j',P_B(g)M}\circ P_A(j')(q_{g,M})\circ c_{A,R_XM}^{-1}=R_{U'}(c_{B,M}^{-1})\circ q_{h,P_B(j)M}\circ P_A(h)(q_{j,M}).$$
The assertion uses no derived category, tensor extension, or open extension, and includes empty schemes and zero rings.

proof.text: The canonical restriction/direct-image comparison is identity on each section by proEtaleRingRestrictionDirectImage_existsUnique. The direct-image compositor is restriction along fibre-product pasting by moduleRComp_existsUnique. Hence the two coefficient-change/composition pastings are equal, using the same restriction map on the same section.

The inverse pullback comparison is by definition the mate of this direct-image comparison. The generic mateSquare calculation and mateEquiv_hcomp transfer the preceding equality to compatibility with moduleGComp, using conjugateEquiv_leftAdjointCompIso_inv.

Apply composition compatibility to (h,j) and (j-prime,g). The generic proved pasteTransport lemma substitutes the equality of composites and cancels the composition isomorphisms. Pass moduleSquareG and its proved defining equation as explicit arguments, retaining the compositor folded in the final specialization.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryRestrictionPullbackSquare {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B)
    {U' U X' X : Scheme.{u}}
    (gU : U' ⟶ U) (j' : U' ⟶ X') (j : U ⟶ X) (g : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : OpenImmersionSquare gU j' j g)
    (M : Scheme.proEtaleRingModules X (Scheme.proEtaleConstantRing X B)) :
    (StrictTower.moduleSquareG (ULift.{u + 1, u} A) gU j' j g sq.toCommSq.w).inv.app
        ((ordinaryScalarRestriction φ X).obj M) ≫
      (ordinaryConstantPullback A j').map ((ordinaryRestrictionComparison φ g).app M) ≫
        (ordinaryRestrictionComparison φ j').app ((ordinaryConstantPullback B g).obj M) =
      (ordinaryConstantPullback A gU).map ((ordinaryRestrictionComparison φ j).app M) ≫
        (ordinaryRestrictionComparison φ gU).app ((ordinaryConstantPullback B j).obj M) ≫
        (ordinaryScalarRestriction φ U').map
          ((StrictTower.moduleSquareG (ULift.{u + 1, u} B) gU j' j g sq.toCommSq.w).inv.app M)
